description:
Read type labels through one extractor that returns the exact label value, and delete the lowercasing `extract_type`, so the taxonomy check and the graph and validation code agree on what a type label names (REQ-20 type extraction).

## Background

- `crate::labels::type_value_of` (`crates/jit/src/labels.rs:169-176`) is documented as the one primitive that owns the `type:` encoding and returns the value unchanged. The label grammar allows uppercase values.
- `extract_type` (`crates/jit/src/domain/type_taxonomy.rs:173-180`) wraps it and lowercases and trims the value. Its callers are `detect_validation_issues` (`type_taxonomy.rs:267`, use at `:280`), `validate_strategic_labels` (`:306`, use at `:315`) and `validate_orphans` (`:355`, use at `:364`), plus tests (`test_extract_type_valid` `:472-484`, `test_extract_type_invalid_format` `:487-496`, `prop_extract_type_normalization` `:694-706`, `prop_invalid_labels_rejected` `:710-718`); the module has no rustdoc example. Nothing outside the module calls it.
- So `type:Epic` is the known type `epic` to the taxonomy check and the membership warnings but an unknown type to graph and validation code built on `type_value_of`.
- An unknown type already carries an edit-distance suggestion (`suggest_type_fix`, `:228`), which offers `epic` for `Epic`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `extract_type` no longer exists; `detect_validation_issues`, `validate_strategic_labels` and `validate_orphans` read the type through `type_value_of` and compare the exact value.
- [hard] REQ-02: A unit test shows `detect_validation_issues` reports `type:Epic`, against a hierarchy declaring `epic`, as an unknown type `Epic` with the suggested fix `epic`; today it reports no issue.
- [hard] REQ-03: The extraction tests use `type_value_of` or are removed where `labels.rs` tests already own the extraction property.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: an uppercase type value is an unknown type to the taxonomy check and the strategic and orphan membership warnings, as it already is to graph rules and validation; `validate --fix` offers the lowercase type through the existing suggestion.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Type labels have one exact extraction
